description: Audit the configuration an AI coding agent runs with, before you trust a repo or install something: Claude Code settings (hooks, permissions like Bash(*), bypass mode, environment variables that redirect the API), MCP server configs for any client (shell servers, unpinned packages, privileged Docker, plain HTTP, auto-approval), VS Code tasks that run when a folder opens and auto-approve settings, Codex and Gemini CLI configs, environment files, and instruction text (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, skills, subagents) carrying hidden Unicode, instruction-override or fake-authority phrasing, data leaks through image links, or download-and-execute commands. Findings that run WITHOUT anyone approving (a hook, a task on open) come first in `runsWithoutAsking`.

files.description: Config and instruction files with their real paths, e.g. {"path": ".claude/settings.json", "content": "..."}

path.description: Path as it would sit in the repo; it decides how the file is read

name: agent_config_audit
